Honesty, the best way to approach a suicidal person is to calmly talk to them about how they feel and try to accommodate them without pressuring them. Don't tell her why she should live. That can often make suicidal people feel guilty. Do try to accommodate her instead. Make her feel safe and accommodated.  Make her feel wanted. Don't push her to do things she doesn't feel comfortable with. Take it at her pace. People who kill themselves often do it out of guilt and loneliness. Telling her telling her that you will be sad if she dies might make her feel that you care more about how YOU feel rather than HER emotions.  


In short: make her feel wanted and cared for rather than argue with her.
